movement_profile.arms_and_hands: raising and lowering swords or canes, tilting the hand to one side
movement_profile.formation_and_space: two rows of men facing each other with a central space

music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by the layered sound of large and small drums providing a steady beat for the rhythmic chanting of poetry.
music_profile.vocal_style: chanted poetry repeated as a refrain

basic_steps: Form two parallel rows facing each other.
Step forward and backward in rhythm with the drums.
Raise and lower the sword or cane in time with the body movement.
Tilt the hand holding the sword to one side.
teaching.formation: Two rows of men facing each other with an open space in the center.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic drumming with a sequence of large to small drums.
